summary: Implemented the engine-free feature. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), plus plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Reduced SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler to thin adapters that delegate to the savers and plot function. Renamed output_path to output_dir in the sliding-window integration test and the two segmentation examples. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Nothing was run or committed; verification was by reading and grep-based lint checks only (no flake8, no tests executed). One inline python3 text-edit was used to strip the old helper from tensorboard_handlers.py.
